_meta.description: Finding-level baseline of PRE-EXISTING editorial findings. Each entry suppresses exactly one finding (path + rule + normalized finding). --all fails on anything not listed; --changed-only fails on anything not listed for that file, so a legacy entry can be edited without re-authoring the debt it already has on record.
_meta.warning: Do not edit by hand. CI fails on findings not listed here and on stale (resolved) entries.
